claim_boundary: Coin Metrics defines RCTC as realized capitalization divided by cumulative miner revenue, or Thermocap, and documents a historical value of ten as indicative of market tops. That interpretation is a primary prior for exactly one fixed risk-veto threshold; it is not evidence that the threshold has point-in-time BTC trading value after costs.

primary_sources.title: Realized Cap to Thermo Cap (RCTC)
primary_sources.use: Primary metric identity, miner-liquidity interpretation and fixed historical market-top threshold of ten.

primary_sources.title: All Time Miner Revenue (USD)
primary_sources.use: Primary definition of RevAllTimeUSD as cumulative miner revenue, also known as Thermocap, and the boundary that fiat-inflow interpretation depends on miner-expense assumptions.

primary_sources.title: Coin Metrics API conventions
primary_sources.use: Primary statement that Community API data can be queried without an API key for free non-commercial use, subject to rate limits and terms.

independence_and_duplicate_boundary.distinct_from_closed_mvrv: The closed MVRV family compared market cap with holder realized cost basis and used a rolling median as DRA entry admission. RCTC compares holder realized cost basis with cumulative miner revenue and uses only the official fixed threshold ten in a passive BTC risk-veto policy.
independence_and_duplicate_boundary.distinct_from_closed_realized_cap_growth: The closed realized-cap family tested four-week directional growth. This family tests a fixed miner-liquidity valuation level and cannot use growth, momentum or alternate lookbacks.
independence_and_duplicate_boundary.distinct_from_closed_miner_revenue_per_h: The closed miner-revenue-per-hash family tested short-horizon miner-economics momentum. This family uses cumulative Thermocap only as the denominator of an official valuation ratio and cannot add hashrate or revenue momentum.
independence_and_duplicate_boundary.prohibited_rescue: Do not replace RCTC with market-cap-to-Thermocap, MVRV, realized-cap growth, miner revenue, hashrate, moving averages, quantiles, z-scores or another threshold after source or outcome access.

adversarial_prior: RCTC is partly constructed from USD-valued on-chain quantities and may encode market-cycle persistence rather than an independent causal mechanism.
A documented historical threshold can still be sample-specific and may fail outside early Bitcoin market cycles.
Realized cap is an approximation of holder cost basis, while Thermocap is cumulative miner revenue rather than observed miner selling or miner balance-sheet stress.
A rare risk-off state can appear to improve drawdown through a few top episodes while destroying upside participation or annual breadth.
Present-vintage Community API history does not prove original daily publication or revision vintages.
stop_conditions: Stop DATA_REJECT before hypothesis or BTC outcome access if exact no-key RCTC daily history cannot be sealed or if either frozen weekly state lacks Design and Validation support, transitions or calendar breadth.
If the source gate passes, freeze exactly one hypothesis and one economic manifest before joining BTC outcomes; no predictive or threshold variant scan is allowed.
Stop NO_CANDIDATE if either Design or Validation fails matched-capital total-PnL, drawdown, Calmar, upside-participation, annual-breadth or concentration gates.
Do not open post-2024 outcomes. Any historical pass remains REPORTED_NOT_ACTIVATED and requires independently sealed OOS.
missing_proof: Community API no-key availability and complete 2018-2024 RCTC daily coverage have not been confirmed or sealed.
Weekly risk-on and risk-off support, transitions and year concentration have not been measured.
No hash-bound hypothesis, manifest, runner or deterministic economic result exists.
No candidate, OOS, forward evidence or activation claim exists.
scope_note: Primary and adversarial prior only. No historical RCTC value or BTC outcome, paid API, second timer, second writer, canonical write, Production, Trading, database, order, fund, OCO, Grid, SHADOW, PAPER or LIVE action occurred.
